title: HECM Rescission, Funding and First-Year Disbursement Limits by Payout Plan
content:
For a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM), this schedule sets the length of the right-of-rescission period, the day the loan funds, the length of the first-year disbursement period and the percentages from which the initial disbursement limit is set at closing.

| | HECM Line of Credit | HECM Tenure Payment Plan | HECM Term Payment Plan | HECM Modified Tenure Plan | HECM Modified Term Plan | HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Right-of-rescission period (rescission business days) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Refund of fees after a timely rescission notice, within (calendar days) | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Rescission business day after closing on which the loan funds | 4th | 4th | 4th | 4th | 4th | 4th |
| First-year disbursement period counted from the closing date (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Initial disbursement limit, percent of the initial principal limit | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 |
| Cushion above mandatory obligations, percent of the initial principal limit | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Whole available principal paid at closing, with no later disbursement | no | no | no | no | no | yes |

A rescission business day is every calendar day except Sundays and federal legal public holidays.

## Points of judgement

- The 60.00 percent figure is used when it exceeds the mandatory-obligations alternative; the 10.00 percent cushion is the part of the initial principal limit allowed above the mandatory obligations when those obligations exceed the percentage limit.
- Only the HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement pays the whole available principal at closing; on the other five plans funds remain to be disbursed after closing.
